```{python}
df = overall_df[
    ["PLAYER_ID", "PLAYER_NAME", "FGM", "FGA"]
].merge(
    player_df[["PLAYER_ID", "FGM", "FGA"]],
    on="PLAYER_ID",
    how="inner",
    suffixes=("_overall", "_clutch")
)

df.head()
```


Excluding players that arent in both dataframes and creating variables specific to their non-clutch performance.
```{python}
df["FGM_nonclutch"] = df["FGM_overall"] - df["FGM_clutch"]
df["FGA_nonclutch"] = df["FGA_overall"] - df["FGA_clutch"]

df = df[
    (df["FGA_clutch"] > 0) &
    (df["FGA_nonclutch"] > 0)
].copy()

df["FG_PCT_clutch"] = df["FGM_clutch"] / df["FGA_clutch"]

df["FG_PCT_nonclutch"] = (
    df["FGM_nonclutch"] / df["FGA_nonclutch"]
)

df["FG_PCT_difference"] = (
    df["FG_PCT_clutch"] - df["FG_PCT_nonclutch"]
)

df[
    [
        "PLAYER_NAME",
        "FGA_clutch",
        "FG_PCT_clutch",
        "FG_PCT_nonclutch",
        "FG_PCT_difference"
    ]
].head()
```

```{python}
df_test = df[df["FGA_clutch"] >= 5].copy()

print(len(df_test))

df_test[
    ["PLAYER_NAME", "FGA_clutch", "FG_PCT_clutch", "FG_PCT_nonclutch"]
].head()
```

```{python}
from scipy import stats

t_stat, p_value = stats.ttest_rel(
    df_test["FG_PCT_clutch"],
    df_test["FG_PCT_nonclutch"]
)

print("Number of players:", len(df_test))

print("t-statistic:", t_stat)
print("p-value:", p_value)
```


We reject the null hypothesis, since the p-value is less than 0.05. The negative t-stat suggests that on average players have a lower FG% in clutch situations.



Look up when each player entered the NBA so I can explore whether experience is related to clutch shooting.
```{python}
from nba_api.stats.endpoints import commonplayerinfo
import pandas as pd
import time

experience = []

for player_id in df_test["PLAYER_ID"]:
    info = commonplayerinfo.CommonPlayerInfo(
        player_id=player_id
    ).get_data_frames()[0]

    experience.append({
        "PLAYER_ID": player_id,
        "FROM_YEAR": int(info["FROM_YEAR"].iloc[0])
    })

    time.sleep(0.6)

experience_df = pd.DataFrame(experience)
```

Add experience information to the player data and calculate years since each player entered the league.
```{python}
df_test = df_test.merge(
    experience_df,
    on="PLAYER_ID",
    how="left"
)

df_test["YEARS_EXPERIENCE"] = (
    2025 - df_test["FROM_YEAR"]
)
```


Split players into two groups based on whether they have fewer than five years of experience.
```{python}
young = df_test[
    df_test["YEARS_EXPERIENCE"] < 5
]["FG_PCT_difference"]

experienced = df_test[
    df_test["YEARS_EXPERIENCE"] >= 5
]["FG_PCT_difference"]

print("Young players:", len(young))
print("Experienced players:", len(experienced))
```


Use a Welch two-sample t-test to compare the average clutch FG% difference between the two experience groups.
```{python}
from scipy import stats

t_stat, p_value = stats.ttest_ind(
    young,
    experienced,
    equal_var=False
)

print("Young mean:", young.mean())
print("Experienced mean:", experienced.mean())
print("t-statistic:", t_stat)
print("p-value:", p_value)
```


Repeat the experience-group comparison with different minimum clutch attempt requirements to see whether the results change.
```{python}
for cutoff in [5, 10, 15, 20, 25]:
    subset = df_test[df_test["FGA_clutch"] >= cutoff].copy()

    young = subset[
        subset["YEARS_EXPERIENCE"] < 5
    ]["FG_PCT_difference"]

    experienced = subset[
        subset["YEARS_EXPERIENCE"] >= 5
    ]["FG_PCT_difference"]

    t_stat, p_value = stats.ttest_ind(
        young, experienced, equal_var=False
    )

    print(f"Cutoff: {cutoff}")
    print(f"Players: {len(subset)}")
    print(f"Mean difference: {young.mean() - experienced.mean():.4f}")
    print(f"p-value: {p_value:.4f}\n")
```

Fit a linear regression to see whether years of NBA experience predict the difference between clutch and non-clutch FG%.
```{python}
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

df_reg = df_test[df_test["FGA_clutch"] >= 10].copy()

model = smf.ols(
    "FG_PCT_difference ~ YEARS_EXPERIENCE",
    data=df_reg
).fit()

print(model.summary())
```

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.api as sm

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))

# Residuals vs fitted
axes[0].scatter(
    model.fittedvalues,
    model.resid,
    alpha=0.6
)
axes[0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Residuals")
axes[0].set_title("Residuals vs. Fitted")

# Normal Q-Q plot
sm.qqplot(
    model.resid,
    line="s",
    ax=axes[1]
)
axes[1].set_title("Normal Q-Q Plot")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

Collect overall and clutch field goal totals for five seasons so I can study whether clutch performance carries over from one year to the next.
```{python}
from nba_api.stats.endpoints import (
    leaguedashplayerclutch,
    leaguedashplayerstats
)
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import time

seasons = [
    "2020-21",
    "2021-22",
    "2022-23",
    "2023-24",
    "2024-25"
]

all_seasons = []

for season in seasons:
    print(f"Collecting {season}...", flush=True)

    clutch = leaguedashplayerclutch.LeagueDashPlayerClutch(
        season=season,
        season_type_all_star="Regular Season",
        clutch_time="Last 5 Minutes",
        point_diff=5,
        ahead_behind="Ahead or Behind",
        measure_type_detailed_defense="Base",
        per_mode_detailed="Totals",
        timeout=60
    ).get_data_frames()[0]

    time.sleep(2)

    overall = leaguedashplayerstats.LeagueDashPlayerStats(
        season=season,
        season_type_all_star="Regular Season",
        measure_type_detailed_defense="Base",
        per_mode_detailed="Totals",
        timeout=60
    ).get_data_frames()[0]

    season_df = overall[
        ["PLAYER_ID", "PLAYER_NAME", "FGM", "FGA"]
    ].merge(
        clutch[["PLAYER_ID", "FGM", "FGA"]],
        on="PLAYER_ID",
        how="inner",
        suffixes=("_overall", "_clutch")
    )

    season_df["SEASON"] = season

    all_seasons.append(season_df)

    print(f"Finished {season}", flush=True)
    time.sleep(2)

multi_year_df = pd.concat(all_seasons, ignore_index=True)

print("Total player-season observations:", len(multi_year_df))
```


Calculate clutch and non-clutch FG% differences for each player in each season, while removing invalid observations.
```{python}
multi_year_df["FGM_nonclutch"] = (
    multi_year_df["FGM_overall"] -
    multi_year_df["FGM_clutch"]
)

multi_year_df["FGA_nonclutch"] = (
    multi_year_df["FGA_overall"] -
    multi_year_df["FGA_clutch"]
)

# Remove invalid observations
multi_year_df = multi_year_df[
    (multi_year_df["FGA_clutch"] > 0) &
    (multi_year_df["FGA_nonclutch"] > 0) &
    (multi_year_df["FGM_nonclutch"] >= 0) &
    (multi_year_df["FGM_clutch"] <= multi_year_df["FGA_clutch"]) &
    (multi_year_df["FGM_nonclutch"] <= multi_year_df["FGA_nonclutch"])
].copy()

multi_year_df["FG_PCT_clutch"] = (
    multi_year_df["FGM_clutch"] /
    multi_year_df["FGA_clutch"]
)

multi_year_df["FG_PCT_nonclutch"] = (
    multi_year_df["FGM_nonclutch"] /
    multi_year_df["FGA_nonclutch"]
)

multi_year_df["FG_PCT_difference"] = (
    multi_year_df["FG_PCT_clutch"] -
    multi_year_df["FG_PCT_nonclutch"]
)

print(multi_year_df.groupby("SEASON").size())
```

Compare the same players in consecutive seasons using Pearson correlations to test whether their clutch FG% differences are repeatable.
```{python}
cutoff = 10

filtered = multi_year_df[
    multi_year_df["FGA_clutch"] >= cutoff
].copy()

wide_df = filtered.pivot(
    index="PLAYER_ID",
    columns="SEASON",
    values="FG_PCT_difference"
)

results = []

for i in range(len(seasons) - 1):
    season1 = seasons[i]
    season2 = seasons[i + 1]

    paired = wide_df[[season1, season2]].dropna()

    if len(paired) >= 3:
        r, p_value = stats.pearsonr(
            paired[season1],
            paired[season2]
        )

        results.append({
            "Season 1": season1,
            "Season 2": season2,
            "Players": len(paired),
            "Pearson r": r,
            "p-value": p_value
        })

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

print(results_df.to_string(index=False))
```


Repeat the year-to-year correlations with different minimum clutch attempt cutoffs to see how sensitive the results are.
```{python}
cutoffs = [5, 10, 15, 20, 25]

cutoff_results = []

for cutoff in cutoffs:

    filtered = multi_year_df[
        multi_year_df["FGA_clutch"] >= cutoff
    ].copy()

    wide = filtered.pivot(
        index="PLAYER_ID",
        columns="SEASON",
        values="FG_PCT_difference"
    )

    for i in range(len(seasons) - 1):
        season1 = seasons[i]
        season2 = seasons[i + 1]

        paired = wide[[season1, season2]].dropna()

        if len(paired) >= 3:
            r, p_value = stats.pearsonr(
                paired[season1],
                paired[season2]
            )

            cutoff_results.append({
                "Cutoff": cutoff,
                "Season 1": season1,
                "Season 2": season2,
                "Players": len(paired),
                "Pearson r": r,
                "p-value": p_value
            })

cutoff_df = pd.DataFrame(cutoff_results)

print(cutoff_df.to_string(index=False))
```


Make scatterplots to visualize the relationship between clutch FG% differences in consecutive seasons.
```{python}
for i in range(len(seasons) - 1):
    season1 = seasons[i]
    season2 = seasons[i + 1]

    paired = wide_df[[season1, season2]].dropna()

    if len(paired) < 3:
        continue

    r, p_value = stats.pearsonr(
        paired[season1],
        paired[season2]
    )

    plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))

    plt.scatter(
        paired[season1],
        paired[season2],
        alpha=0.6
    )

    # Fitted regression line
    slope, intercept = np.polyfit(
        paired[season1],
        paired[season2],
        1
    )

    x = np.linspace(
        paired[season1].min(),
        paired[season1].max(),
        100
    )

    plt.plot(x, slope * x + intercept)

    plt.axhline(0, color="gray", linestyle="--")
    plt.axvline(0, color="gray", linestyle="--")

    plt.xlabel(f"{season1} Clutch FG% Difference")
    plt.ylabel(f"{season2} Clutch FG% Difference")

    plt.title(
        f"{season1} vs. {season2}\n"
        f"r = {r:.3f}, p = {p_value:.4f}, n = {len(paired)}"
    )

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```


Combine consecutive-season observations for a descriptive overall correlation. Players can appear more than once, so the usual p-value is not a reliable independent-observation test.

```{python}
all_pairs = []

for i in range(len(seasons) - 1):
    season1 = seasons[i]
    season2 = seasons[i + 1]

    paired = wide_df[[season1, season2]].dropna().copy()

    paired.columns = ["Previous", "Next"]
    paired["Season_Pair"] = f"{season1} to {season2}"
    paired["PLAYER_ID"] = paired.index

    all_pairs.append(paired.reset_index(drop=True))

pooled_df = pd.concat(all_pairs, ignore_index=True)

r, p_value = stats.pearsonr(
    pooled_df["Previous"],
    pooled_df["Next"]
)

print("Total season pairs:", len(pooled_df))
print("Pooled correlation:", r)
print("Naive p-value:", p_value)
```

Calculate 95% confidence intervals to show the uncertainty around each year-to-year FG% correlation.
```{python}
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

results_df["CI_lower"] = np.nan
results_df["CI_upper"] = np.nan

for i, row in results_df.iterrows():
    filtered = multi_year_df[
        multi_year_df["FGA_clutch"] >= 10
    ]

    wide = filtered.pivot(
        index="PLAYER_ID",
        columns="SEASON",
        values="FG_PCT_difference"
    )

    paired = wide[
        [row["Season 1"], row["Season 2"]]
    ].dropna()

    result = stats.pearsonr(
        paired[row["Season 1"]],
        paired[row["Season 2"]]
    )

    ci = result.confidence_interval(
        confidence_level=0.95
    )

    results_df.loc[i, "CI_lower"] = ci.low
    results_df.loc[i, "CI_upper"] = ci.high

print(results_df.to_string(index=False))
```


Collect free throw makes and attempts for the same five seasons to see whether clutch FT% is more consistent than FG%.
```{python}
from nba_api.stats.endpoints import (
    leaguedashplayerclutch,
    leaguedashplayerstats
)
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import time

seasons = [
    "2020-21",
    "2021-22",
    "2022-23",
    "2023-24",
    "2024-25"
]

all_ft_seasons = []

for season in seasons:
    print(f"Collecting {season}...", flush=True)

    clutch = leaguedashplayerclutch.LeagueDashPlayerClutch(
        season=season,
        season_type_all_star="Regular Season",
        clutch_time="Last 5 Minutes",
        point_diff=5,
        ahead_behind="Ahead or Behind",
        measure_type_detailed_defense="Base",
        per_mode_detailed="Totals",
        timeout=60
    ).get_data_frames()[0]

    time.sleep(2)

    overall = leaguedashplayerstats.LeagueDashPlayerStats(
        season=season,
        season_type_all_star="Regular Season",
        measure_type_detailed_defense="Base",
        per_mode_detailed="Totals",
        timeout=60
    ).get_data_frames()[0]

    season_df = overall[
        ["PLAYER_ID", "PLAYER_NAME", "FTM", "FTA"]
    ].merge(
        clutch[["PLAYER_ID", "FTM", "FTA"]],
        on="PLAYER_ID",
        how="inner",
        suffixes=("_overall", "_clutch")
    )

    season_df["SEASON"] = season
    all_ft_seasons.append(season_df)

    print(f"Finished {season}", flush=True)
    time.sleep(2)

ft_df = pd.concat(all_ft_seasons, ignore_index=True)

print("Total player-season observations:", len(ft_df))
```


Calculate each player’s clutch and non-clutch FT% and the difference between them.
```{python}
ft_df["FTM_nonclutch"] = (
    ft_df["FTM_overall"] - ft_df["FTM_clutch"]
)

ft_df["FTA_nonclutch"] = (
    ft_df["FTA_overall"] - ft_df["FTA_clutch"]
)

# Remove observations with no free throw attempts
ft_df = ft_df[
    (ft_df["FTA_clutch"] > 0) &
    (ft_df["FTA_nonclutch"] > 0) &
    (ft_df["FTM_nonclutch"] >= 0) &
    (ft_df["FTM_clutch"] <= ft_df["FTA_clutch"]) &
    (ft_df["FTM_nonclutch"] <= ft_df["FTA_nonclutch"])
].copy()

ft_df["FT_PCT_clutch"] = (
    ft_df["FTM_clutch"] / ft_df["FTA_clutch"]
)

ft_df["FT_PCT_nonclutch"] = (
    ft_df["FTM_nonclutch"] / ft_df["FTA_nonclutch"]
)

ft_df["FT_PCT_difference"] = (
    ft_df["FT_PCT_clutch"] -
    ft_df["FT_PCT_nonclutch"]
)

print(ft_df.groupby("SEASON").size())
print(ft_df["FTA_clutch"].describe())
```


Test whether clutch FT% differences are correlated across consecutive seasons, using at least five clutch free throw attempts per season.
```{python}
cutoff = 5

filtered_ft = ft_df[
    ft_df["FTA_clutch"] >= cutoff
].copy()

wide_ft = filtered_ft.pivot(
    index="PLAYER_ID",
    columns="SEASON",
    values="FT_PCT_difference"
)

ft_results = []

for i in range(len(seasons) - 1):
    season1 = seasons[i]
    season2 = seasons[i + 1]

    paired = wide_ft[[season1, season2]].dropna()

    if len(paired) >= 4:
        result = stats.pearsonr(
            paired[season1],
            paired[season2]
        )

        ci = result.confidence_interval(0.95)

        ft_results.append({
            "Season 1": season1,
            "Season 2": season2,
            "Players": len(paired),
            "Pearson r": result.statistic,
            "p-value": result.pvalue,
            "CI_lower": ci.low,
            "CI_upper": ci.high
        })

ft_results_df = pd.DataFrame(ft_results)

print(ft_results_df.to_string(index=False))
```

Check how the FT% correlations change when I require different numbers of clutch free throw attempts.
```{python}
cutoffs = [3, 5, 10, 15, 20]

ft_cutoff_results = []

for cutoff in cutoffs:
    filtered = ft_df[
        ft_df["FTA_clutch"] >= cutoff
    ]

    wide = filtered.pivot(
        index="PLAYER_ID",
        columns="SEASON",
        values="FT_PCT_difference"
    )

    for i in range(len(seasons) - 1):
        season1 = seasons[i]
        season2 = seasons[i + 1]

        paired = wide[[season1, season2]].dropna()

        if len(paired) >= 4:
            r, p_value = stats.pearsonr(
                paired[season1],
                paired[season2]
            )

            ft_cutoff_results.append({
                "Cutoff": cutoff,
                "Season 1": season1,
                "Season 2": season2,
                "Players": len(paired),
                "Pearson r": r,
                "p-value": p_value
            })

ft_cutoff_df = pd.DataFrame(ft_cutoff_results)

print(ft_cutoff_df.to_string(index=False))
```


Collect three-point makes and attempts to test whether clutch three-point shooting is consistent across seasons.
```{python}
from nba_api.stats.endpoints import (
    leaguedashplayerclutch,
    leaguedashplayerstats
)
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import time

seasons = [
    "2020-21",
    "2021-22",
    "2022-23",
    "2023-24",
    "2024-25"
]

all_3pt_seasons = []

for season in seasons:
    print(f"Collecting {season}...", flush=True)

    clutch = leaguedashplayerclutch.LeagueDashPlayerClutch(
        season=season,
        season_type_all_star="Regular Season",
        clutch_time="Last 5 Minutes",
        point_diff=5,
        ahead_behind="Ahead or Behind",
        measure_type_detailed_defense="Base",
        per_mode_detailed="Totals",
        timeout=60
    ).get_data_frames()[0]

    time.sleep(2)

    overall = leaguedashplayerstats.LeagueDashPlayerStats(
        season=season,
        season_type_all_star="Regular Season",
        measure_type_detailed_defense="Base",
        per_mode_detailed="Totals",
        timeout=60
    ).get_data_frames()[0]

    season_df = overall[
        ["PLAYER_ID", "PLAYER_NAME", "FG3M", "FG3A"]
    ].merge(
        clutch[["PLAYER_ID", "FG3M", "FG3A"]],
        on="PLAYER_ID",
        how="inner",
        suffixes=("_overall", "_clutch")
    )

    season_df["SEASON"] = season
    all_3pt_seasons.append(season_df)

    print(f"Finished {season}", flush=True)
    time.sleep(2)

threept_df = pd.concat(all_3pt_seasons, ignore_index=True)

print("Total player-season observations:", len(threept_df))
```

Calculate clutch and non-clutch 3P% differences for each player.
```{python}
threept_df["FG3M_nonclutch"] = (
    threept_df["FG3M_overall"] -
    threept_df["FG3M_clutch"]
)

threept_df["FG3A_nonclutch"] = (
    threept_df["FG3A_overall"] -
    threept_df["FG3A_clutch"]
)

# Remove invalid observations
threept_df = threept_df[
    (threept_df["FG3A_clutch"] > 0) &
    (threept_df["FG3A_nonclutch"] > 0) &
    (threept_df["FG3M_clutch"] >= 0) &
    (threept_df["FG3M_nonclutch"] >= 0) &
    (threept_df["FG3M_clutch"] <= threept_df["FG3A_clutch"]) &
    (threept_df["FG3M_nonclutch"] <= threept_df["FG3A_nonclutch"])
].copy()

threept_df["FG3_PCT_clutch"] = (
    threept_df["FG3M_clutch"] /
    threept_df["FG3A_clutch"]
)

threept_df["FG3_PCT_nonclutch"] = (
    threept_df["FG3M_nonclutch"] /
    threept_df["FG3A_nonclutch"]
)

threept_df["FG3_PCT_difference"] = (
    threept_df["FG3_PCT_clutch"] -
    threept_df["FG3_PCT_nonclutch"]
)

print(threept_df.groupby("SEASON").size())
print(threept_df["FG3A_clutch"].describe())
```


Calculate year-to-year correlations in clutch 3P% differences, again starting with a five-attempt minimum.
```{python}
cutoff = 5

filtered_3pt = threept_df[
    threept_df["FG3A_clutch"] >= cutoff
].copy()

wide_3pt = filtered_3pt.pivot(
    index="PLAYER_ID",
    columns="SEASON",
    values="FG3_PCT_difference"
)

threept_results = []

for i in range(len(seasons) - 1):
    season1 = seasons[i]
    season2 = seasons[i + 1]

    paired = wide_3pt[[season1, season2]].dropna()

    if len(paired) >= 4:
        result = stats.pearsonr(
            paired[season1],
            paired[season2]
        )

        ci = result.confidence_interval(0.95)

        threept_results.append({
            "Season 1": season1,
            "Season 2": season2,
            "Players": len(paired),
            "Pearson r": result.statistic,
            "p-value": result.pvalue,
            "CI_lower": ci.low,
            "CI_upper": ci.high
        })

threept_results_df = pd.DataFrame(threept_results)

print(threept_results_df.to_string(index=False))
```



### Monte Carlo Simulation:


Prepare the free throw data for a Monte Carlo simulation, keeping players with at least five clutch attempts.
```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

cutoff = 5

sim_df = ft_df[
    ft_df["FTA_clutch"] >= cutoff
].copy()

sim_df = sim_df[
    (sim_df["FTA_nonclutch"] > 0) &
    sim_df["FT_PCT_nonclutch"].notna()
].copy()

print("Player-season observations:", len(sim_df))
print("Unique players:", sim_df["PLAYER_ID"].nunique())
```


Simulate clutch free throws 1,000 times using each player’s non-clutch FT% as their shooting probability. This shows what year-to-year correlations could look like without an additional clutch effect.

```{python}
np.random.seed(42)

n_simulations = 1000

seasons = [
    "2020-21",
    "2021-22",
    "2022-23",
    "2023-24",
    "2024-25"
]

season_pairs = list(zip(seasons[:-1], seasons[1:]))

simulation_results = []

# Actual correlations
actual_wide = sim_df.pivot(
    index="PLAYER_ID",
    columns="SEASON",
    values="FT_PCT_difference"
)

actual_correlations = {}

for season1, season2 in season_pairs:
    paired = actual_wide[[season1, season2]].dropna()

    actual_correlations[(season1, season2)] = (
        stats.pearsonr(
            paired[season1],
            paired[season2]
        ).statistic
    )

# Monte Carlo simulation
for simulation in range(n_simulations):

    simulated = sim_df.copy()

    simulated["FTM_clutch_sim"] = np.random.binomial(
        n=simulated["FTA_clutch"].astype(int).to_numpy(),
        p=simulated["FT_PCT_nonclutch"].to_numpy()
    )

    simulated["FT_PCT_clutch_sim"] = (
        simulated["FTM_clutch_sim"] /
        simulated["FTA_clutch"]
    )

    simulated["FT_PCT_difference_sim"] = (
        simulated["FT_PCT_clutch_sim"] -
        simulated["FT_PCT_nonclutch"]
    )

    wide_sim = simulated.pivot(
        index="PLAYER_ID",
        columns="SEASON",
        values="FT_PCT_difference_sim"
    )

    for season1, season2 in season_pairs:
        paired = wide_sim[[season1, season2]].dropna()

        if (
            len(paired) >= 4
            and paired[season1].std() > 0
            and paired[season2].std() > 0
        ):
            r = stats.pearsonr(
                paired[season1],
                paired[season2]
            ).statistic

            simulation_results.append({
                "Simulation": simulation,
                "Season 1": season1,
                "Season 2": season2,
                "Pearson r": r
            })

simulation_df = pd.DataFrame(simulation_results)

print("Simulations completed:", n_simulations)
```


Compare the actual FT% correlations with the simulated correlations to see whether the observed results are unusual under this simplified chance model.
```{python}
comparison_results = []

for season1, season2 in season_pairs:

    simulated_r = simulation_df[
        (simulation_df["Season 1"] == season1) &
        (simulation_df["Season 2"] == season2)
    ]["Pearson r"]

    actual_r = actual_correlations[(season1, season2)]

    # Two-sided Monte Carlo p-value
    extreme = np.sum(
        np.abs(simulated_r) >= abs(actual_r)
    )

    p_value = (extreme + 1) / (len(simulated_r) + 1)

    comparison_results.append({
        "Season 1": season1,
        "Season 2": season2,
        "Actual r": actual_r,
        "Mean simulated r": simulated_r.mean(),
        "Simulated 2.5%": simulated_r.quantile(0.025),
        "Simulated 97.5%": simulated_r.quantile(0.975),
        "Monte Carlo p-value": p_value
    })

comparison_df = pd.DataFrame(comparison_results)

print(comparison_df.to_string(index=False))
```

The observed year-to-year FT% correlations are consistent with random shooting variation under the simplified no-clutch-effect model.
